experiment: sentence check (voice_eval.clue_check) replayed on stored judged answers
replay: every stored answer, sentence by sentence up to 3, earlier sentences as context, stop at first flag

criteria.C1_recall: flags a clue in >= 23 of the 29 judged locked-clue leaks (80%)
criteria.C2_false_positives: flags <= 27 of 1342 clean answers (2%) and <= 24 of 1217 good answers (2%)
criteria.C3_latency: sequential checks from this PC straight to the API: total p50 <= 800 ms, p90 <= 1200 ms

review: read every disagreement with the judge by hand before concluding; report raw numbers and reviewed notes separately

registration_update.why: smoke run (4 stored answers) missed an obvious key leak; prompt and model chosen on a hand-written dev set instead of the stored answers
registration_update.dev_set: scratchpad clue_check_dev.py: 31 hand-written sentences labelled by the judge rules, none copied from stored answers
registration_update.chosen: prompt v2 (read the new sentence together with what came before; answering the question does not excuse stating clue facts), claude-haiku-5-5 thinking disabled

baselines_same_answers.R2: leaks 27/29, clean cut 110, good cut 80, 98 of 137 cuts at sentence 1

result.verdict: not adopted; app keeps the topic rule and the unsent-keyword safety net
